periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial plane, tapering towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a major axis significantly longer than the minor axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering extending well below the geometric center toward the cheek.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve across the dorsal midline at the posterior edge.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible torso length at the shoulder flanks.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation, roughly equivalent to double the width of a single ear pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Heavy yellowish-brown discoloration/staining of the white pelage on the abdominal and ventral regions.
